en: Black‑and‑white landscape view across a calm river or lake, framed by tall conifer trees in the foreground. On the left stands a wooden, likely dark‑painted house close to the water's edge. In the distance, on the opposite bank, there is an industrial complex with a very tall chimney stack and several low factory buildings surrounded by trees. The setting appears rural and heavily forested, with soft rolling terrain. No visible caption or printed text appears on the image side.
